_doc: Cross-promotion registry. Brands, the CLAIMS made about them (each with a verification status and sourcing), and PROMOS that place a brand on a surface. Rendering is done by scripts/promo.mjs, which is independent of the bookstore so other sites can reuse it. A production build (FM_ENV=production) refuses to run while any placed promo is unapproved, has no URL, or relies on an unverified claim or an unauthorised badge. See docs/CROSS-PROMOTION.md.

nvidiaInception.note: No authorised badge asset is in this repository and no Inception-specific usage terms were found. Enabling requires ALL of: asset file present under assets-src/partner/, licenseConfirmed=true (written authorisation or the member-portal terms), guidelinesUrl and guidelinesReviewedOn set. Never recreate, redraw, recolour or restyle NVIDIA marks, and do not use NVIDIA's green or imitate its visual style.

Record the date and what you checked in `evidence`/`verifiedOn`, then set status to "verified".
